title: Betanin improves motor function and alleviates experimental Parkinsonism via downregulation of TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB pathway: Molecular docking and biological investigations.
authors: ElSayed, Mohamed H; Atif, Huda M; Eladl, Mohamed Ahmed; Elaidy, Samah M; Helaly, Ahmed M N; Hisham, Fatma Azzahraa; Farag, Noha E; Osman, Noura M S; Ibrahiem, Afaf T; Khella, Heba W Z; Bilasy, Shymaa E; Albalawi, Marzough Aziz; Helal, Mohamed A; Alzlaiq, Wafa Ali; Zaitone, Sawsan A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甜菜苷通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kB通路改善帕金森病小鼠运动功能，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neuroinflammatory and degenerative disease. In this study, we investigated the neuroprotective action of betanin in the rotenone-induced Parkinson-like mice model. Twenty-eight adult male Swiss albino mice were divided into four groups: Vehicle, Rotenone, Rotenone + Betanin 50 mg/kg, and Rotenone + Betanin 100 mg/kg. Parkinsonism was induced by subcutaneous injection of 9 doses of rotenone (1 mg/kg/48 h) plus betanin at 50 and 100 mg/kg/48 h in rotenone + betanin groups for twenty days. Motor dysfunction was assessed after the end of the therapeutic period using the pole, rotarod, open-field, grid, and cylinder tests. Malondialdehyde, reduced glutathione (GSH), Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), myeloid differentiation primary response-88 (MyD88), nuclear factor kappa- B (NF-kappaB), neuronal degeneration in the striatum were evaluated. In addition, we assessed the immunohistochemical densities of tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) in Str and in substantia nigra compacta (SNpc). Our results showed that rotenone remarkably decreased (results of tests), increased decreased TH density with a significant increase in MDA, TLR4, MyD88, NF-kappaB, and a decrease in GSH (p < 0.05). Treatment with betanin significantly results of tests), increased TH density. Furthermore, betanin significantly downregulated malondialdehyde and improved GSH. Additionally, the expression of TLR4, MyD88, and NF-kappaB was significantly alleviated. Betanin's powerful antioxidative and anti-inflammatory properties can be related to its neuroprotective potential as well as its ability to delay or prevent neurodegeneration in PD.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）是一种进行性神经炎症和退行性疾病。在本研究中，我们探讨了甜菜红素（betanin）在鱼藤酮诱导的帕金森样小鼠模型中的神经保护作用。将二十八只成年雄性瑞士白化小鼠分为四组：溶剂对照组（Vehicle）、鱼藤酮组（Rotenone）、鱼藤酮+甜菜红素50 mg/kg组，以及鱼藤酮+甜菜红素100 mg/kg组。通过皮下注射9次鱼藤酮（1 mg/kg/48 h）诱导帕金森病，同时在鱼藤酮+甜菜红素组中给予50和100 mg/kg/48 h的甜菜红素，持续二十天。治疗期结束后，使用杆状测试（pole test）、旋转杆测试（rotarod test）、开放场测试（open-field test）、网格测试（grid test）和圆柱测试（cylinder test）评估运动功能障碍。评估了丙二醛（malondialdehyde）、还原型谷胱甘肽（reduced glutathione, GSH）、Toll样受体4（Toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）、髓样分化初级反应蛋白88（myeloid differentiation primary response-88, MyD88）、核因子kappa-B（nuclear factor kappa-B, NF-kappaB）以及纹状体中的神经元变性。此外，我们评估了酪氨酸羟化酶（tyrosine hydroxylase, TH）在纹状体（Str）和黑质致密部（substantia nigra compacta, SNpc）中的免疫组织化学密度。我们的结果显示，鱼藤酮显著降低了（测试结果），增加了TH密度降低，并伴有MDA、TLR4、MyD88、NF-kappaB的显著升高，以及GSH的降低（p < 0.05）。甜菜红素治疗显著改善了（测试结果），增加了TH密度。此外，甜菜红素显著下调了丙二醛并改善了GSH。同时，TLR4、MyD88和NF-kappaB的表达显著缓解。甜菜红素强大的抗氧化和抗炎特性可能与其神经保护潜力及其在PD中延缓或预防神经变性的能力相关。
